# EvInputDate

> A date input with a trailing calendar icon and a date-picker dropdown (slot). It comes in two sizes, supports validation, and shares the same interaction states as InputField.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:input-date` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvInputDate } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvInputDate>` or `<ev-input-date>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/input-date/EvInputDate.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<div class="ev-input-date__content">`, not the root |

## Example

```vue
<EvInputDate
  placeholder="Select"
  label="Tanggal jatuh tempo"
/>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Input**, frame `4690:5067` (Input Date). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to collect a single calendar date (e.g. birth date, due date).
- Use the Small size in dense forms or tables.
- Use the calendar slot to let users pick a date visually.
- Use validation text to guide correction inline.
- Use the disabled state when the date is not editable.

### When not to use

- Don't use for free-form text  →  use InputField (`evoq-ui:input`).
- Don't use for time of day  →  use InputTime (`evoq-ui:input-time`).
- Don't use for a date range in one field if both ends need separate validation.
- Don't hide the expected date format from the user.

### Do

- Show the expected format (e.g. DD MMM YYYY) in the placeholder.
- Keep the calendar icon visible as an affordance.
- Show validation text close to the field, on error.
- Use one consistent size within a form.

### Don't

- Rely on the placeholder alone as the label.
- Use red borders without an explanatory message.
- Mix Default and Small sizes in the same form.
- Disable a field without making the reason clear.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvInputDate`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<div class="ev-input-date__content">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:input-date` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
